programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: 2012 wurde Erik Poltorak in Los Angeles ermordet, um zu verhindern, dass er in einem Prozess gegen Michael Thomas aussagt, der ihn im Jahr zuvor ausgeraubt hatte. Michael Thomas hatte den Mord vom Gefängnis aus arrangiert und den Freund seiner Nichte, Allen Williams, als Schützen angeheuert, während seine Freundin als Komplizin fungierte und seine Nichte Schmiere stand. Sie führten den Mord an Halloween aus und nutzten die Feierlichkeiten als Tarnung. Williams, der ein Kostüm trug, erschoss Poltorak vor seiner Haustür. Michael Thomas wurde für schuldig befunden und zum Tode verurteilt,.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: 1990 wurde die Studentin und Ex-Freundin von Bart Corbin, Dolly Hearn, tot in ihrer Wohnung in Augusta, Georgia, aufgefunden, was zunächst als Selbstmord gewertet wurde. 14 Jahre später, im Jahr 2004, wurde auch Jennifer Corbin, Barts Ehefrau, unter ähnlichen Umständen in ihrem Haus in Buford, Georgia, tot aufgefunden. Die Ermittlungen ergaben, dass Bart Corbin beide Frauen ermordet und ihren Tod so inszeniert hatte, dass er wie ein Selbstmord aussah. 2006 gestand Bart Corbin beide Morde im Rahmen eines Vergleichs, um der Todesstrafe zu entgehen.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters halten eine verdächtige Frau auf, die versucht, ihre Identität zu verbergen, während die Agenten an anderer Stelle das Haus eines Menschenhändlers umstellt haben, als es in Flammen aufgeht. Außerdem jagen sie eine Frau, die auf der Most-Wanted-Liste des FBI steht, und machen sich nachts auf die Suche nach einem bewaffneten und gefährlichen Flüchtling.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters gehen undercover, um einen Drogenhändler aufzuspüren, der sich in einer Küstenstadt versteckt, und begeben sich dann ins Rotlichtviertel, um nach einer wegen Drogenschmuggels verurteilten Frau zu suchen. Als Nächstes führen die Agenten eine verdeckte Operation durch, um einen Mann festzunehmen, der in Oregon wegen Verbrechen an Minderjährigen gesucht wird.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Zwischen 2006 und 2008 werden sechs Frauen im Bereich der Ramsey Street in Fayetteville, North Carolina, auf brutale Art und Weise vergewaltigt. Obwohl den Ermittlern klar wird, dass wahrscheinlich derselbe Täter dahintersteckt, haben sie immer noch Mühe, ihn zu identifizieren. Können 15 Jahre später neue Technologien den Serienvergewaltiger endlich vor Gericht bringen?

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Bothel, Washington, 1993: Als die 15-jährige Melissa Lee verschwindet, ist ihre Familie, die in einem Vorort von Seattle lebt, am Boden zerstört. Die Suche nach der Vermissten wird schnell zu einer Mordermittlung, die die Ermittler vor ein Rätsel stellt, als Melissas Leiche in einem Fluss gefunden wird. Obwohl die Polizei in den 90er Jahren Mühe hatte, eine solide Spur zu finden, können moderne Ermittler 30 Jahre später vielleicht neue, innovative forensische Methoden einsetzen, um den brutalen Mörder endlich zu finden.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Nachdem ein Verdächtiger mit einer Limousine verunglückt ist, flüchtet er in ein unwegsames Waldgebiet und weigert sich, sich zu ergeben. Kann "Chase" die Pattsituation beenden? Als ein Mann droht, sich selbst etwas anzutun, ziehen die Polizisten "Milo" hinzu, um die Situation unter Kontrolle zu bringen. Unterdessen steht "Nicky" vor einem Wettlauf gegen die Zeit. Ein vermisstes Kleinkind ist in der weiten Natur verloren gegangen, während das Tageslicht schnell schwindet. Und "Duder" wird hinzugezogen, um bei der Suche nach einem Verdächtigen zu helfen, der sich seit Wochen den Ermittlern entzieht.

programme.title: Der British-Airways-Killer

programme.title: Der British-Airways-Killer
programme.desc: Ein Geständnis, eine Leiche, die im Windsor Great Park gefunden wurde, und komplexe polizeiliche Ermittlungen führen zu einem schockierenden Prozess.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: In Tulsa, Oklahoma, wird ein Vater von sechs Kindern erschossen in einem Obdachlo-senlager aufgefunden. Die Ermittler müssen sich an diese Gemeinschaft wenden, um Hilfe zu erhalten.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Nachdem Tom Bragg und sein Zwillingsbruder Tim 2002 bei einem Dachdeckerunfall verletzt worden waren, musste Toms Frau Mary Ann sich um sie kümmern. Später im selben Jahr wurde Tom mit Kopfverletzungen tot in seinem Haus aufgefunden. Die Ermittlungen ergaben, dass Mary Ann heimlich eine Lebensversicherung in Höhe von 25.000 Dollar auf Tom abgeschlossen hatte und sich nach seiner Verletzung nicht mehr um ihn kümmern wollte. Sie wurde 2005 verhaftet und 2006 des Mordes an Tom für schuldig befunden. Sie erhielt eine lebenslange Haftstrafe plus 20 Jahre für schwere Körperverletzung.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Alexandra "Zandra" Ducsay hatte eine schwierige Vergangenheit mit ihrem Highschool-Freund Matthew Pugh, der gewalttätig war und sie sogar bedrohte, während er wegen Drogenvergehen im Gefängnis saß. Am 19. Mai 2006 wurde Zandra von ihrer Mutter ermordet im Keller ihres Hauses aufgefunden. Die Polizei hatte zunächst keine Hinweise, auch nicht nach der Befragung von Pugh, der ein Alibi hatte. Der Fall blieb jahrelang ungeklärt. 2012 kam schließlich der Durchbruch, als Pughs Cousin dessen Plan, Zandra zu töten, offenbarte. Pugh wurde verhaftet und schließlich verurteilt.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters suchen nach einem Mann, der wegen versuchten Mordes an seiner Freundin in San Diego gesucht wird. Als Nächstes begeben sie sich in ein vom Kartell kontrolliertes Gebiet auf die Jagd nach einem verurteilten Menschenhändler und auf die Suche nach einer Drogenschmugglerin, die nie zweimal am selben Ort schläft.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters jagen einen verurteilten Drogenhändler, der sein Leben riskiert, um zu entkommen. Dann finden die Agenten eine Spur zu einer Frau, die in San Diego wegen Mordes gesucht wird und sich seit drei Jahren in Tijuana versteckt hält.

programme.title: Interview mit einem Mörder
programme.desc: Eine Dreiecksbeziehung endet tödlich: Im Jahr 2009 erstach ein Teenager aus Florida seine Rivalin wegen eines Ex-Freundes. Die Fernsehübertragung des Prozesses fesselte die Menschen. Als Rachel Wades Behauptung der Notwehr von der Jury zurückgewiesen wurde, wurde sie für schuldig befunden und zu einer Haftstrafe verurteilt. Nun, da ihr abscheuliches Verbrechen schon Jahre zurückliegt, denkt Wade über das fehlgeleitete Mädchen nach, das sie einst war, und darüber, was sie dazu gebracht hat, einem anderen Teenager das Leben zu nehmen.

programme.title: Interview mit einem Mörder
programme.desc: Seit Jahren versucht die Kleinstadt Olney zu verstehen, wie und warum der Teenager Julius Mullins die Mutter seiner Ex-Freundin ermorden konnte. David Scott konfrontiert Mullins auf eine Weise, wie er es noch nie zuvor getan hat.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: In Tulsa, Oklahoma, wird ein Vater von sechs Kindern erschossen in einem Obdachlo-senlager aufgefunden. Die Ermittler müssen sich an diese Gemeinschaft wenden, um Hilfe zu erhalten.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Der Promi-Friseur Fabio Sementilli schien alles zu haben - Ruhm, eine liebevolle Familie, einen luxuriösen Lebensstil. Doch nachdem er erstochen aufgefunden wurde und sein Sportwagen gestohlen worden war, deckten die Ermittler einen erschreckenden Plan auf.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Susan Mauldin verschwand während einer Renovierung aus ihrem Haus in Florida. Eine Spur aus Bankunterlagen und Überwachungsaufnahmen führte die Ermittler zu dunklen Familiengeheimnissen - und dem perfiden Plan eines Mörders.

programme.title: Court Cam - Auf der Anklagebank
programme.desc: Nach acht Monaten auf der Flucht steht der frühere Anwalt Richard Merritt wegen des Mordes an seiner 77 jährigen Mutter Shirley vor Gericht. Die Staatsanwaltschaft beschreibt ihn als manipulativen Täter, der seine Mutter brutal getötet und sich dann versteckt hat. Die Verteidigung hält dagegen: Sie behauptet, Shirley sei von Menschen ermordet worden, die Merritt zuvor betrogen hatte. Nun müssen die Geschworenen entscheiden, ob sie seiner Darstellung glauben - oder ob er den Rest seines Lebens im Gefängnis verbringen wird.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Nachdem Tom Bragg und sein Zwillingsbruder Tim 2002 bei einem Dachdeckerunfall verletzt worden waren, musste Toms Frau Mary Ann sich um sie kümmern. Später im selben Jahr wurde Tom mit Kopfverletzungen tot in seinem Haus aufgefunden. Die Ermittlungen ergaben, dass Mary Ann heimlich eine Lebensversicherung in Höhe von 25.000 Dollar auf Tom abgeschlossen hatte und sich nach seiner Verletzung nicht mehr um ihn kümmern wollte. Sie wurde 2005 verhaftet und 2006 des Mordes an Tom für schuldig befunden. Sie erhielt eine lebenslange Haftstrafe plus 20 Jahre für schwere Körperverletzung.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Alexandra "Zandra" Ducsay hatte eine schwierige Vergangenheit mit ihrem Highschool-Freund Matthew Pugh, der gewalttätig war und sie sogar bedrohte, während er wegen Drogenvergehen im Gefängnis saß. Am 19. Mai 2006 wurde Zandra von ihrer Mutter ermordet im Keller ihres Hauses aufgefunden. Die Polizei hatte zunächst keine Hinweise, auch nicht nach der Befragung von Pugh, der ein Alibi hatte. Der Fall blieb jahrelang ungeklärt. 2012 kam schließlich der Durchbruch, als Pughs Cousin dessen Plan, Zandra zu töten, offenbarte. Pugh wurde verhaftet und schließlich verurteilt.

programme.title: Im Angesicht
programme.desc: Fast 25 Jahre lang war Michel Guillaume Kriminalhauptkommissar Theo Renner in der Krimiserie "SOKO München". Lange bevor der gefragte Schauspieler Erfolge im TV feierte, wuchs Guillaume als Kind in kriminellem Umfeld auf. Aus dieser schwierigen Zeit in seinem Leben berichtet Guillaume in "Im Angesicht" nun erstmals vor der Kamera. "Mein Vater war ein Gangster.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Nachdem ein Verdächtiger mit einer Limousine verunglückt ist, flüchtet er in ein unwegsames Waldgebiet und weigert sich, sich zu ergeben. Kann "Chase" die Pattsituation beenden? Als ein Mann droht, sich selbst etwas anzutun, ziehen die Polizisten "Milo" hinzu, um die Situation unter Kontrolle zu bringen. Unterdessen steht "Nicky" vor einem Wettlauf gegen die Zeit. Ein vermisstes Kleinkind ist in der weiten Natur verloren gegangen, während das Tageslicht schnell schwindet. Und "Duder" wird hinzugezogen, um bei der Suche nach einem Verdächtigen zu helfen, der sich seit Wochen den Ermittlern entzieht.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: Nachdem eine vierfache Mutter aus North Charleston erschlagen in einem Gebüsch aufgefunden wurde, liefert sich ein junger Kriminalbeamter im Verhörraum ein hartes Duell mit ihrem mutmaßlichen Mörder.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Zunächst wurde angenommen, dass Shele Danishefsky Covlin, eine erfolgreiche Finanzmanagerin in New York, 2009 durch einen Unfall in der Badewanne gestorben war. Allerdings kamen Verdachtsmomente gegen ihren entfremdeten Ehemann Roderick Covlin auf, die dazu führten, dass ihre Leiche exhumiert wurde. Dabei stellte sich heraus, dass Shele erwürgt worden war. Roderic wurde zum Hauptverdächtigen. Nach einem langwierigen Prozess wurde er für schuldig befunden und zu 25 Jahren Gefängnis für den Mord an Shele verurteilt - ein Fall, der von Habgier, Verrat und einem inszenierten Tatort geprägt war.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: 2015 wurde Ashley Melnyczok, eine 27-jährige Escortdame in Colorado Springs, von den Ex-Soldaten Joseph Kimsey und Jonathan Nelson ermordet, die es auf das Bargeld abgesehen hatten, das sie in ihrem Haus aufbewahrte. Die Tat, die ursprünglich als Einbruch geplant war, entwickelte sich zu einem brutalen Mord. Kimsey, der eine romantische Beziehung zu Melnyczok hatte, und Nelson, der Kimsey im Gefängnis kennengelernt hatte, wurden wegen Mordes ersten Grades verurteilt. Ihr Prozess offenbarte eine Mischung aus persönlichen und finanziellen Motiven sowie einen schweren Mangel an Empathie.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters versuchen, einen Mann zu fassen, der wegen Mordes an seiner Frau in Kalifornien gesucht wird, während eine Amerikanerin aus dem ländlichen New York im Gefängnis in Mexiko landet. Die Agenten helfen dann einem amerikanischen Teenager-Mädchen, Gerechtigkeit zu erfahren.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters arbeiten mit der mexikanischen Armee zusammen, weil ihre Zielperson Verbindungen zu einem berüchtigten Drogenkartell hat. Anschließend halten die Agenten ein verdächtiges Auto an und finden zwei Männer auf einer tödlichen Mission.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Im ländlichen Florida wurde eine schwangere junge Frau mit dem Gesicht nach unten am Straßenrand gefunden - mit einem Schädelbruch und aufgeschlitzter Kehle. Der grauenhafte Anblick ließ die Ermittler rätseln, wer ein solch abscheuliches Verbrechen begangen haben könnte. Die Antwort war unerwartet und schockierend.

programme.title: Crime in Progress - Verbrechen in Echtzeit
programme.desc: Nach einem verzweifelten Notruf eilen Rettungssanitäter und Deputy-Sheriffs herbei, um das Leben einer Mutter zu retten, die plötzlich aufgehört hat zu atmen. Es entsteht eine angespannte Situation in Echtzeit, als ihr Partner sich weigert, mit der Polizei zu kooperieren. Durch die Linsen der Bodycams wird jeder entscheidende Moment festgehalten, während die Deputy-Sheriffs versuchen, herauszufinden, was passiert ist.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: Nachdem eine vierfache Mutter aus North Charleston erschlagen in einem Gebüsch aufgefunden wurde, liefert sich ein junger Kriminalbeamter im Verhörraum ein hartes Duell mit ihrem mutmaßlichen Mörder.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Die Polizei fand die nackten Leichen von drei Frauen, die erschossen und in abgelegenen Gebieten außerhalb von Daytona Beach zurückgelassen worden waren. Es war ein Serienmörder am Werk. Der Fall blieb fast ein Jahrzehnt lang ungelöst, bis die Entdeckung eines vierten weiblichen Opfers forensische DNA-Spuren lieferte, die die Ermittler zu einem unvorhergesehenen Mörder führten.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Shanti Cooper-Tronnes wurde tot in der Badewanne aufgefunden, eine Woche bevor ihr Haus für eine Renovierungssendung im Fernsehen ausgewählt wurde. Ihr Ehemann David behauptete, es handele sich um einen Unfall, doch die Ermittler deckten eine Geschichte voller Lügen und Täuschungen auf.

programme.title: Court Cam - Auf der Anklagebank
programme.desc: 35 Jahre nachdem die zwölfjährige Jonelle Matthews aus ihrem Zuhause in Greeley, Colorado, verschwunden war, fand man ihre Leiche. Die Ermittler klagen den ehemaligen Gouverneurskandidaten von Idaho, Steve Pankey, wegen Mordes an. Pankey beteuert seine Unschuld und wird vor Gericht die Indizienlage des Falles darlegen. Aber wird das ausreichen, um einen Freispruch zu erwirken?

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Im ländlichen Florida wurde eine schwangere junge Frau mit dem Gesicht nach unten am Straßenrand gefunden - mit einem Schädelbruch und aufgeschlitzter Kehle. programme.title: Im Angesicht
programme.desc: Als Eva Habermann Fanpost von einem scheinbar älteren Herrn erhielt, dachte sie sich anfangs nicht viel dabei. Doch als der Absender die Zufahrt zu ihrem Haus versperrte, um seine Liebe zu offenbaren, merkte die Schauspielerin, dass die Zuneigung problematische Züge annahm. Der damals 21-jährige Stalker ging so weit, dass er hinter dem Haus ihrer Wohnung campierte, Sturm klingelte und nachts Steinchen gegen das Fenster warf - bis Habermann wieder bei ihren Eltern einzog. In "Im Angesicht" berichtet sie von ihren Erfahrungen und sagt: "Was es in mir ausgelöst hat, ist eine größere Wachsamkeit.".

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Der Polizeihund "Cisco" rückt zu einem Einbruch an einem Ort aus, den man am allerwenigsten erwarten würde - der Loge des Berufsverbands der Polizei. Unterdessen wird der Polizeihund "Karma" gegen einen aggressiven Verdächtigen eingesetzt, der sich der Festnahme widersetzt. Nachdem sein Hundeführer von einem Fahrzeug angefahren wurde, setzt der Polizeihund "Jakko" die Verfolgung allein fort und nimmt die Fährte eines bewaffneten Verdächtigen auf. Als der Polizeihund "Mickey" den Verdächtigen schließlich zu Boden bringt, zahlt er dafür einen schmerzhaften Preis.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Im ländlichen Florida wurde eine schwangere junge Frau mit dem Gesicht nach unten am Straßenrand gefunden - mit einem Schädelbruch und aufgeschlitzter Kehle. Der grauenhafte Anblick ließ die Ermittler rätseln, wer ein solch abscheuliches Verbrechen begangen haben könnte. Die Antwort war unerwartet und schockierend.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, the horrifying murder of Archbishop Thomas Becket of Canterbury led thousands of pilgrims to the south of England. Centuries later, the long-forgotten Pilgrims' Way is now enjoying a revival. The Pilgrim´s Way leads east to west cross-country from Winchester to Canterbury through the counties of Hampshire, Surrey and Kent. Along the way, modern pilgrims discover traces of the past and the pristine beauty of the land. They meet people who want to preserve England's rich natural treasures and traditions for the future.

programme.title: ECO CIDE
programme.desc: In 2010, BP's Deepwater Horizon oil rig exploded killing 11 men. Over 200 million gallons of oil poured into the sea for 3 months impacting an area the size of England and Scotland combined. The first oil spills washed ashore on Grand Isle, Louisiana. Years later, while the authorities and the US government claim that the shore is completely safe, locals assert that they are still facing the effects of the world's biggest oil spill. This feature documents the impact the spill had on Grand Isle's health, economy and businesses, and how it continues to haunt them.

programme.title: Suppressed Science S1 - "Race: Science, Social Construct, or Both?"
programme.desc: The concept of race was invented during colonial and imperialist eras as a means to reify political power structures.

programme.title: Suppressed Science S1 - "Human Enhancement"
programme.desc: From a cutting-edge, science-based gym & spa, to a medical clinic that offers direct ultrasound brain stimulation designed to increase mental performance.

programme.title: Supersonic: The Great Adventure
programme.desc: The epic story of 70 years of supersonic innovation, from Chuck Yeager's breakthrough to the future of flight.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Winter Flying"
programme.desc: Anthony shows us the different methods to keep yourself and your plane warmed up in those cold winter months.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Night Time Flying"
programme.desc: Kurtis and Anthony take us night flying. Some say it's more beautiful... while others think it's more dangerous!

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Guardian Angels"
programme.desc: Experiencing an aviation emergency where the calm voice on the other end of the radio helps get our pilot out of trouble.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Oxygen Lab"
programme.desc: Kurtis experiences oxygen deprivation in the High Altitude Lab at Embry Riddle University.

programme.title: Deep Rising
programme.desc: 'Deep Rising' narrated and executive produced by Jason Momoa, takes viewers on journey from the oceans depths to the future of sustainable energy.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
programme.desc: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Constructions"
programme.desc: Discover the worst bridge collapses and tunnel fires in history.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Hurricanes"
programme.desc: Explore with us one of the most destructive and deadliest hurricanes in history!

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Earthquakes"
programme.desc: Explore with us the most destructive earthquakes in history, can we even protect ourselves from this natural disaster?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Rotoscoping"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll discuss the animation technique of Rotoscoping, take another look at card tricks, the history of juggling and the popularity of the Smart phone.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
programme.desc: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Yanukovych's Hidden Palace"
programme.desc: Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur"
programme.desc: Casa Poporlui is the magnum opus of Romania’s most bloodthirsty dictator, Nicolae Ceausescu, and hides secrets of an extensive underground bunker system.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programme.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
programme.desc: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
programme.desc: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "The People's Car"
programme.desc: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
programme.desc: The incredible story of the arms race to create America's nuclear arms factories.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "The Kamikaze Bullet"

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Deep in the backroads of the Midwest there are stories locals rarely tell out loud. Stories of pale figures with oversized heads watching from the trees. Stories passed down in whispers and warnings. The Melon Heads legend has haunted Michigan, Ohio, and surrounding states for decades. Some say they are the result of dark experiments. Others believe they are something far older. Something that never left the woods.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff hear about the dangers of fishing for Bluefin Tuna in the Atlantic Ocean from locals in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Then they head 30 miles out onto the open ocean with Darrin of Reel Respect Charters in the hopes of landing their own giant.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff team up with their friends from Boss Shotshells in South Dakota for a high-energy upland hunt, pursuing wild pheasants with the help of skilled hunting dogs. The adventure takes a quirky turn with a visit to the iconic Corn Palace.

With the pre-rut in full swing, most Ibex are in small bachelor groups. It's only a matter of time before Mark spots a mature trophy—requiring skill, patience, and a solid understanding of this rugged terrain.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson returns to the stunning island of Dugi Otok in Croatia for his third time in pursuit of a Kri Kri ibex. This Mediterranean gem offers a true sportsman's paradise, home to an incredible variety of huntable species. While the island presents opportunities for Axis Deer and other game—which Mark briefly glasses during his adventure—the primary focus remains on connecting with a quality Kri Kri Ibex. Join Mark as he navigates the familiar yet ever-challenging terrain of Dugi Otok.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along with Mark Peterson as he heads north to Nunavut within the Arctic Circle. On this trip, he has brought along his Gunwerks muzzleloader as well as his Gunwerks rifle. With two Caribou tags and a Musk Ox tag in his pocket, he’s excited to put both firearms to use. The muzzleloader is up to bat first. With the rocky, wide open tundra terrain it makes it more of a challenge to get close enough with the muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson has one more tag in his pocket after harvesting both a Central Barren Ground Caribou and a Muskox with his Gunwerks muzzleloader on day one. This time, he has his Gunwerks rifle in hand. The conditions have been perfect, but there is a front pushing in with a ton of rain coming so Mark is eager to fill his final tag before the bad weather hits. Spotting a large group of Caribou with one big one mixed in early on in the day, he is hoping to have success and end his trip to Nunavut off with a bang!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: It's the second day of the Alabama Turkey season, and we hit the woods with Dr. Mike Chamberlain and Aaron Warbritton from The Hunting Public in search of a longbeard. Watching turkeys just being turkeys, and spending time with great friends is why turkey hunting is just different to us.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This one is special. We took Ron aka “Don”, a WoodHaven employee who helps assemble our pot calls, out to Tennessee for a turkey hunt he’ll never forget. After 35 years of not harvesting a Turkey, Don finally gets his shot.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for — cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This Kentucky trip is one we’ll be talking about for a long time. Three longbeards hit the ground, but honestly, it’s the time spent in the woods with good friends that made this hunt what it was. We had birds gobbling, lots of laughs, and a memories that will last a lifetime, and that’s what makes turkey hunting so addicting. These are the kind of hunts you don’t take for granted.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia
programme.desc: Brown bears, wolves, lynx, eagles… where within the European Union are these carnivores still regular inhabitants? Where can you find mountainous regions that yet wait to be discovered by mass tourism?

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: The Green Heart of Croatia - At the Banks of River Sava
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay - World Heritage and Water Paradise
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: This “cult classic” comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: In this zany biopic, Vin Diesel stars as gangster Jackie DiNorscio, who represented himself in the longest criminal trial in American history. With Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Cuba Gooding Jr. stars as an ex-felon on a path of redemption, defying convention when he establishes a chess club for inner-city teenagers in D.C.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: A man must survive a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment. Starring movie icon Jean-Claude Van Damme.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: A tough cop (Jason Statham) is dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: While on a hiking trip to reconnect with his son after the death of his wife, Ray Keene (John Cusack) stumbles into a nightmare scenario of paid assassins and ex-military guns for hire led by the mysterious Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman).

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: One Black and one white woman in 1955 Montgomery, Alabama must decide what they are going to do in response to the famous bus boycott led by Martin Luther King. Starring Whoopi Goldberg ("Ghost") and Sissy Spacek ("In the Bedroom").

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: In this crime thriller, mercenary John Seeger (Steven Seagal, "Exit Wounds") attempts to break into Eastern Europe's most impenetrable prison and free the son of a notorious drug lord.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A decorated homicide detective (Steven Seagal) journeys through Memphis' depraved underworld to face off against a perverse serial killer in this action thriller.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: In this twisting cop thriller, an alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic after a serial killer targets his friends and family.

programme.title: Blunt Force Trauma
programme.desc: Motivated by victory and revenge, modern duelists John and Colt take on the underground gunfighting world. Starring Ryan Kwanten, Freida Pinto and Mickey Rourke.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Donovan's Echo
programme.desc: When a series of deja vu events occur, a man (Danny Glover) is forced to re-examine his past and future.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner (Dolph Lundgren, "Rocky IV") in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped American woman.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Held for ransom, a married couple’s predicament grows increasingly dire amid the discovery of betrayal and deception. Starring Nicolas Cage ("Leaving Las Vegas") and Nicole Kidman ("Moulin Rouge!").

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Concrete Canyons
programme.desc: In this thrilling crime drama, a sheriff (Scott Patterson, "Saw V") searches for his son who is accused of murder and on the run from the law.

programme.title: 90s Vault
programme.desc: Unlocking the 90s hits you forgot you loved.

programme.title: Totally 90s Anthems
programme.desc: Start the day with the 90s anthems everyone knows.

programme.title: 90s Mixtape Wake-Up
programme.desc: Wake up to the ultimate 90s mixtape.

programme.title: Press Replay: 90s Mornings
programme.desc: Press play on your favorite 90s hits all over again.

programme.title: 90s Archive
programme.desc: The biggest hits of the decade, straight from the archive.

programme.title: 90s Desktop Jams
programme.desc: Power through your 9-to-5 with nonstop 90s hits.

programme.title: Straight Up 90s Hits
programme.desc: Hit play for the best of the 90s.

programme.title: 90s Dial-Up Classics
programme.desc: Log on to the classics that defined a generation.
